q: Cracker unit uses children in powder mixing, shows school holiday and wage slips. Officer recalls precedent making employer fund welfare. Order?
options: Stop hazard, rescue, prosecute, levy rehab fund and school them
expl: Precedent bans hazard plus employer-paid rehab and schooling.
why: Hard case blends ban with liability. Welfare fund is not optional charity.

q: State caps fees and seats in minority colleges so medium and hiring choice vanish. Trust cites autonomy ruling. Balance?
options: Uphold autonomy, allow standards but strike character-killing rules
expl: Autonomy allows quality norms, not nationalisation of character.
why: Case law draws line at destruction. Excellence can coexist with identity.

q: Mock option says shrine entry for all ages is finally decided and no review exists. Examiner expects trap detection. Pick?
options: Pending before larger bench, do not mark as settled, follow interim
expl: Larger review pending. Settled claim is trap.
why: Cross-day caution applies. Field obedience stays to interim while law awaits final word.

q: AP highway dhaba holds tribal girls for labour, transit across two new districts, night operation, family fears arrest misuse. As SI lead?
options: Rescue, new-code FIR, cross-district alerts, women safeguards, child panel
Single station FIR only, night raid without witness
expl: AP 26-district mesh plus new-code safeguards drive SOP.
why: AP application tests coordination. Safeguards protect victims and case strength.

q: Old city minority school feud spills to road, aided school nearby turns away pupils on faith. Crowd gathers. Priorities?
options: Separate crowds, protect children, refer admission to officers, act on identity denial
expl: Keep peace, guard pupils, route academic dispute to forum.
why: AP field craft is order first, merits later. Identity denial gets legal lens.

q: Assembly passes quota for all colleges including minority and punishment for faith tax. Governor assents. Fate?
options: Quota fails for minority, punishment fails for want of Parliament source
Punishment passes, quota fails only partly
expl: Minority skip plus Parliament-only punishment both hit State law.
why: Institutional reasoning stacks two exclusions. Assent cannot cure competence lack.

q: IG orders blanket phone taps on soldiers and civilians citing discipline and speed, no law shown. Review?
options: Needs Parliament law for forces and fair procedure for others, order fails
expl: Source plus fairness both needed. Executive need alone fails.
why: Institutional check separates forces channel from citizen liberty. Both need legal backing.

q: Trust school created for faith teaching, now State-run, continues teaching. Claim says even this tiny survival is barred because State touches it. Extreme?
options: Survival allowed as narrow settlor exception
expl: Narrow exception saves endowment intent despite State admin.
why: Extreme exception trap tests edge memory. Touch alone does not kill trust purpose.

q: Unqualified person holds municipal chair for months, passes orders, challenges to title raised late. Relief by function?
options: Question authority and test title, past acts need separate review
expl: Title testing fits usurpation. Delay does not cure lack of authority.
why: Extreme case trap mixes delay with de facto acts. Title inquiry stays open.

q: Migrant bonded child denied aided admission on tongue, trafficked, brother detained, officer silent. Map full State response?
options: Rescue plus BNS, rehab plus school, admission enforced, produce plus command orders
expl: Grand synthesis links labour, child, equality, culture and remedies.
why: Synthesis is the whole syllabus in one victim. Each right triggers its forum together.
